    budget = case['budget']
    n = len(segments)

    importances = [seg['importance'] for seg in segments]
    minima = [seg['minimum'] for seg in segments]
    capacities = [seg['capacity'] for seg in segments]
    
    total_min = sum(minima)
    total_cap = sum(capacities)
    
    if budget < total_min or budget > total_cap:
        raise ValueError('Budget out of feasible range')
    
    # Initialize allocations at minimum
    alloc = minima[:]
    allocated = total_min
    
    # While budget remains
    while allocated < budget:
        best_idx = -1
        best_ratio = -1.0
        for i in range(n):
            if alloc[i] < capacities[i]:
                ratio = importances[i] / (alloc[i] + 1)
                # Tie-break by original index (lower index better)
                if ratio > best_ratio or (ratio == best_ratio and (best_idx == -1 or i < best_idx)):
                    best_ratio = ratio
                    best_idx = i
        # best_idx must be valid because total_cap >= budget
        alloc[best_idx] += 1
        allocated += 1
    
    # Build output
    by_name = {names[i]: alloc[i] for i in range(n)}
    return {
        'allocations': alloc,
        'by_name': by_name,
        'total': allocated
    }"
}
